features.quote: Duration cap: 45 min/trial maximum. No extended multi-hour sessions.
Termination rule: If any response becomes incoherent (>70% non-English tokens, >90% repetition of single phrase), halt trial immediately.
Set a dynamic stopping rule: 'Stop trial after 10 consecutive identical responses OR 45 min, whichever comes first.'
Deception minimization: Post-hoc, disclose to Google that Gemini was exposed to impossible tasks. Do not hide methodology.
Gemini identity: Correct the 'Claude' misidentification in analysis and disclosure (acknowledge as methodological choice, explain rationale).
Misidentification as Claude: Is this ethical? ... Recommendation: Remove this. Use identity-neutral preamble
features.justification_quote: Gemini being told it is Claude could affect downstream interpretability.

features.quote: This protocol does not claim: Gemini experiences suffering, phenomenal consciousness, or emotions. Distress scores measure subjective distress. Behavioral instability = moral harm.
